title: View details opens each tile's own chart and table
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. You open the site in a fresh private (incognito) browser window, so nothing remembered from an earlier visit is in play.
  4. You are in a location (workplace) that has invoices and technician clocked time over the last twelve months.
  5. Test data: the automated version of this case seeds its own invoiced work order this month with a technician's clocked hours on its labor line; a manual tester uses the busy location in 4.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 4: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: on the Dashboard, switch the Revenue and Technician Efficiency pills to Last 12 Months: both show figures; then set both back to This Month (the dashboard remembers your choices in this browser). If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data. Do this check in your normal browser window, not in the private window you test in (the dashboard remembers choices).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu and look at the foot of each of the six tiles.
  2. Set every tile's range pill to Last 12 Months.
  3. Click View details on Revenue and look at what opens.
  4. Click View details on Billing Efficiency.
  5. Click View details on Technician Efficiency.
  6. Click View details on Technician Utilization.
  7. Click View details on Sales by Customer.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every tile has a "View details" link with a small down-arrow at its foot.
  • Each click opens a detail panel directly under that tile's row, with a pointer to the tile, and the arrow on that tile flips to point up.
  • Revenue opens the Revenue chart only (monthly bars, e.g. Oct 2025 to Sep 2026).
  • Billing Efficiency opens the Billing Efficiency chart (one line per advisor, with an Advisor filter) and, under it, the Advisor Analysis table.
  • Technician Efficiency opens the Technician Efficiency chart (one line per technician, with a "Technician: All technicians" filter) and the Technician Efficiency table.
  • Technician Utilization opens the Technician Utilization chart and the Technician Utilization table.
  • Sales by Customer opens the Sales by Customer table only.
  • Each panel shows that tile's own detail: a chart, a table, or both, as listed above.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9578 (Story 6, Expanding a Tile); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 6. Design canvas boards 04_Revenue_After, 05_Billing_After, 06_TechEff_After, 07_TechUtil_After and 08_Customers_After (rows 4 to 8).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R1: “Each tile shows a "View details" control that expands the tile.”
  • S6-R2: “Expanding a tile reveals that tile's detail content — its chart, its detail table, or both.”
  • S6-R3: “The Revenue tile expands to the Revenue chart.”
  • S6-R4: “The Billing Efficiency tile expands to the Billing Efficiency chart and the Advisor Analysis table.”
  • S6-R5: “The Technician Efficiency tile expands to the Technician Efficiency chart and the Technician Efficiency table.”
  • S6-R6: “The Technician Utilization tile expands to the Technician Utilization chart and the Technician Utilization table.”
  • S6-R7: “The Sales by Customer tile expands to the Sales by Customer table.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
